description:
## Goal

Brands should be associated with a scenario from the moment of creation, not as a separate assignment step. Add a scenario picker component that lets users search and select a target scenario during brand creation, and manage the assignment from the brand detail page.

## Current State

- Brands are created standalone via `POST /api/v1/brands` with no scenario reference
- Assignment is a separate step via `POST /api/v1/assignments` with `{brand_id, scenario_name, elements[]}`
- The BrandFormPage has no scenario selection UI
- The BrandDetailPage doesn't show which scenario the brand is assigned to

## Implementation

### Scenario Picker Component
- Reusable dialog/dropdown that lists available scenarios
- Search/filter functionality (by name)
- Scenario cards showing: name, description, status, whether it already has a brand assigned
- Single-select (one brand per scenario, enforced by UNIQUE constraint on assignments table)

### Brand Creation Flow
- Add scenario picker to BrandFormPage (optional but prominent)
- When a scenario is selected:
  - Pre-fill brand name from scenario's display name if available
  - After brand creation, automatically create the assignment
  - Show which elements will be applied (colors, typography, identity, etc.)
- When no scenario is selected: create brand standalone (current behavior preserved)

### Brand Detail Page
- Show assigned scenario (if any) with a badge/link
- "Change Scenario" button to reassign
- "Unassign" option to remove the association
- If no scenario assigned, show "Assign to Scenario" prompt

### API for Scenario List
- The scenario list can be sourced from the filesystem (`scenarios/` directory) or from a Vrooli CLI call
- Endpoint: `GET /api/v1/scenarios` (list available scenarios with basic metadata)
- Filter: name search, exclude already-assigned scenarios (optional)

## Key Files

- Brand form: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/pages/BrandFormPage.tsx`
- Brand detail: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/pages/BrandDetailPage.tsx`
- Assignment handler: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/handlers/` (CreateAssignment)
- Domain types: `scenarios/brand-manager/api/domain/types.go` (Assignment struct)
- API client: `scenarios/brand-manager/ui/src/lib/api.ts`
name: brand-manager-scenario-picker
title: Add Scenario Picker to Brand Creation and Detail Flows
